title: He Lost $7 Billion and Nobody Noticed for a Year #shorts
description:
In 2008, a junior trader at Societe Generale hid fake trades behind a mountain of bets worth fifty billion euros. The bank found out too late.
Follow for more stories of money that vanished overnight.
hook_text:
HE LOST
$7 BILLION
AND NOBODY NOTICED
first_comment: Did Kerviel act alone, or did the bank look away as long as he was making money? 👇

lines.text: In January 2008, a French bank discovered it had lost seven billion dollars.
His name was Jerome Kerviel, and he was thirty-one.
He knew exactly how the bank's controls worked.
So he made fake trades, to hide the real ones.
Behind them, he built a bet worth fifty billion euros.
More than the whole bank was worth.
For a year, no one stopped him.
Then the auditors found a trade that didn't exist.
The bank had three days to close everything, while markets crashed worldwide.
The final loss: four point nine billion euros.
Kerviel was sentenced to five years, but claimed his bosses knew.
Follow for more stories of money that vanished overnight.
